description: TFW Assisted lifecycle checks for a standalone project root.

hooks.command: sh -c 'd=$PWD; while :; do s=$d/.codex/hooks/tfw-hook.sh; if [ -f "$s" ]; then exec sh "$s" SessionStart; fi; [ "$d" = / ] && exit 0; d=${d%/*}; [ -n "$d" ] || d=/; done'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$d=(Get-Location).Path; while($true){$s=Join-Path $d '.codex/hooks/tfw-hook.ps1'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $s){& $s SessionStart; exit $LASTEXITCODE}; $p=Split-Path -Parent $d; if($p -eq $d){exit 0}; $d=$p}"
